titles: 백록담은 왜 자꾸 바닥을 드러낼까 (feat. 천지와 완전히 다른 이유)
백록담과 천지가 완전히 다른 이유 (feat. 둘 다 화산 호수인데)
백록담은 마르는데 천지는 왜 안 마를까 (feat. 그릇이 다르다)

image_concepts.A: 가득 찬 천지 칼데라 vs 바닥이 드러난 백록담 화구, 나란히 단면 컷어웨이
image_concepts.B: 꺼지는 산꼭대기 — 사라진 옛 꼭대기 윤곽 아래 내려앉은 넓은 분지(시간 겹치기 단면)

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A, 단면 컷어웨이(A-2). 같은 축척으로 나란히 자른 두 산꼭대기 그릇. 왼쪽 천지 칼데라는 깊은 청록 물이 가장자리까지 가득, 오른쪽 백록담 화구는 바닥이 갈라진 채 웅덩이만 조금. 백록담 바닥 흙층 아래로 물이 새는 모습.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A detailed cutaway cross-section view revealing the interior of two volcanic mountain summits placed side by side at the same scale in the upper part of the frame: on the left, the summit of Baekdu Mountain with a huge, wide and very deep caldera basin brimming to the rim with deep teal water; on the right, the summit of Hallasan on Jeju Island with a much smaller bowl-shaped crater (Baengnokdam) ringed by a pale trachyte cliff on one side and dark porous basalt on the other, its floor almost dry and cracked with only a small teal puddle, and thin glowing streaks showing water seeping down through a loose sandy sediment layer beneath it. Warm orange-brown rock layers contrast with the teal water and a clear sky-blue background. No people.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A, 내려다보기(D) + 투명 투시(E). 위에서 비스듬히 내려다본 두 그릇. 천지 칼데라는 물이 반투명하게 비쳐 바닥의 분화구가 보이고, 옆의 백록담은 거의 마른 작은 화구.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A high oblique aerial view looking down into two volcanic summit lakes side by side: on the left, Heaven Lake (Cheonji) on Baekdu Mountain, a vast round caldera lake whose teal water is rendered semi-transparent so the deep basin floor and a separate smaller crater on its western floor glow through the water; on the right, Baengnokdam on the summit of Hallasan, a small oval crater with a nearly dry cracked muddy floor and only a shallow puddle. The giant caldera fills most of the upper frame, the small crater sits beside it for scale. Rocky orange-brown rims, light snow patches, clear bright sky. No people.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B, 단면 + 시간 겹치기(B). 반투명한 빛으로 남은 옛 뾰족한 산꼭대기 윤곽 아래, 비어 버린 마그마 자리 위로 산꼭대기가 내려앉아 넓은 분지가 된 모습. 분지 바닥에 물이 차기 시작한다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. A cross-section of Baekdu Mountain showing how a caldera forms: the outline of the old pointed summit floats above as a translucent glowing ghost shape, while below it the real summit has sunk down into a wide flat-floored basin bounded by steep ring faults. Beneath the basin, a partly emptied underground magma chamber is drawn as a dim orange cavity, showing the roof lost its support. Fresh teal water is beginning to pool on the basin floor. Calm, clear sky, no smoke or explosion, no people.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 변형, 원리 시각화(F). 같은 크기의 두 산을 나란히: 왼쪽은 땅속에서 용암이 위로 솟아 테두리를 쌓는 작은 화구(빛나는 위쪽 화살 모양 흐름), 오른쪽은 땅속이 비어 산꼭대기가 아래로 내려앉는 큰 분지(아래로 향하는 빛 흐름). 글자·화살표 없이 흐름으로만.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. Two volcanic cones shown in cross-section side by side across the upper frame to visualize two opposite processes: on the right, a smaller volcano where glowing orange lava rises up a narrow conduit and builds a raised rim around a small summit crater; on the left, a larger volcano whose summit has sagged downward into a broad deep basin because the glowing chamber beneath it is half empty, with soft luminous streaks flowing downward along the sunken block. Each summit bowl holds a little teal water. Bright clean background, no arrows, no people.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드, 투명 투시(E) + 원리 시각화(F). 한라산 정상에 굵은 비가 쏟아지는데, 백록담 바닥은 말라 갈라져 있고 투명하게 비친 바닥 흙 속으로 빗물이 빠르게 빠져나가는 모습. 멀리 오른쪽 위에 작게, 물이 가득 찬 천지.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Detailed semi-realistic digital illustration in the style of a Korean educational YouTube thumbnail: clean dark ink outlines, cel shading with soft painted gradients, rich saturated colors with strong warm orange and cool teal contrast, bright high-key lighting, crisp textures, slightly exaggerated perspective. Not a photograph. Heavy rain pours from dark-edged clouds onto the summit of Hallasan, yet the oval crater lake Baengnokdam below is almost dry, its cracked muddy floor showing only a shallow puddle. The ground under the crater floor is rendered semi-transparent, revealing a loose sandy-gravel sediment layer where glowing teal streaks of rainwater drain quickly downward and away. In the far upper corner, small and distant, the wide caldera lake Heaven Lake on Baekdu Mountain sits brimming with deep teal water for contrast. Bright, saturated colors, no people.
